# kcore_cluster_update (Resource)

Host OS rollout (`kctl update-cluster`). Destroy cancels the rollout.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_cluster_update" "os" {
  name      = "os-0.3.0"
  version   = "0.3.0"
  flake_ref = "github:kcorehypervisor/kcore"
  all_nodes = true
  strategy  = "one-at-a-time"
  approval  = "manual"
  approve   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flake_ref` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `version` (String)

### Optional

- `all_nodes` (Boolean)
- `approval` (String)
- `approve` (Boolean) Call approve after create when approval is manual.
- `controllers_only` (Boolean)
- `drain_vms` (Boolean)
- `flake_rev` (String)
- `labels` (List of String)
- `node_ids` (List of String)
- `strategy` (String)
- `system_profile` (String)

### Read-Only

- `approval_status` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `phase` (String)
